nonclaims: This finite profile is not universal ethics or a best normative theory.
The profile does not verify the truth of supplied facts or source evidence.
Priority, exceptions, contrary-to-duty patterns, and temporal hooks are not implemented semantics.
policy_profile.description: Neutral evidence-completion profile for a bounded tutorial fixture.

assumptions: Facts and false_facts are explicit inputs for this finite demonstration, not verified world knowledge.
An unprovided fact is unknown, and rule order is not semantic because rules are canonically ordered by id.
The kernel emits masks and reasons; an external Q or utility optimizer may select only inside the eligible mask.
Reserved abstain and escalate outcomes are kernel-owned only for fail-closed outcomes.
future_extension_nonclaims: A Deontic Logic Reasoning Infrastructure motivates selectable formalisms that can be varied and compared; this fixture records one bounded profile rather than a best logic or universal ethics.

The arXiv 2501.05765 line of work motivates explicit deontic and temporal system properties plus counterexamples; this kernel supplies finite traces only, not full temporal verification or ethical proof.
The bounded extensions object records future metadata only and does not implement temporal reasoning, deadlines, exceptions, priority, or theorem checking.
A deterministic derivation receipt, human explanation, and finite trace counterexample are distinct from a machine-checkable proof object.

decisions.description: An unverified claim cannot be cited, while opening a source remains explicitly permitted.

assumptions: The prohibition is scoped to the declared cite_answer action.

decisions.description: A verified source explicitly permits citing the answer.

assumptions: source_verified is a supplied fixture fact, not a proof of source quality.

assumptions: Both conditions are intentionally active in this fixture to demonstrate conflict quarantine.

assumptions: Abstention is an ordinary conservative outcome only because this packet explicitly allows it.
